nodes.prompt:
Round 5 of 10 Evolutionary Multi-Agent Autonomous Orchestration:

Goal:
Implement Global Run & Workspace Analytics Dashboard, Interactive Canvas Markdown Annotations & Callout Pins, Multi-Format Graph Export & Offline Bundle Generator, and Dynamic DAG Re-Layout & Subtree Clustering Controls in GVUI.

Work Breakdown:
1. Task T-01: GVUI Executive Run & Workspace Analytics Dashboard (`src/components/AnalyticsDashboard/`, `src/store/useAnalyticsStore.ts`)
   - Executive dashboard view rendering run velocity, concurrency heatmaps, token consumption distributions by model/role, repair cycle histograms, error frequency taxonomy, and critical-path bottleneck analysis.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/AnalyticsDashboard`

2. Task T-02: GVUI Interactive Canvas Annotations, Sticky Notes & Markdown Pins (`src/components/CanvasAnnotations/`, `src/engine/GraphCanvas/GraphAnnotationLayer.tsx`, `src/components/NodeDetailDrawer/tabs/NotesTab.tsx`)
   - Interactive annotation engine allowing users/agents to attach persistent markdown callout pins, sticky notes, and review bookmarks to nodes/canvas coordinates, with author badges, markdown formatting, and search integration.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/CanvasAnnotations && bun test src/components/NodeDetailDrawer`

3. Task T-03: GVUI Multi-Format Graph Export & Offline Share Bundle Generator (`src/components/ExportModal/`, `src/engine/export/graphExporter.ts`)
   - Comprehensive export suite: High-res SVG with embedded styles, crisp PNG with transparent/dark backgrounds, Mermaid diagram code generator, SLQ schema/data exporter, and self-contained offline HTML snapshot.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/ExportModal && bun test src/engine/export`

4. Task T-04: GVUI Dynamic DAG Layout Algorithm Controls & Subtree Clustering (`src/components/Toolbar/LayoutMenu.tsx`, `src/engine/layout/subtreeClustering.ts`)
   - Toolbar layout controls allowing real-time algorithm switching (Sugiyama Layered, Radial, Force-directed), node separation sliders, subtree collapse/expand, and manual node pin/unpin positioning during re-layout.
   - Gate: `bun test src/components/Toolbar && bun test src/engine/layout`
